description: Karte von der Eisenbahn zwischen Potsdam und Berlin, 1838 is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Landesvermessung und Geobasisinformation Brandenburg (LGB). The historical map - railway between Potsdam and Berlin - was published by the Brandenburg State Survey in 1990 as a colour reproduction. The originals are in the State Library of Prussian Cultural Heritage in Berlin. Coverage: the railway between Potsdam and Berlin (LGB). The portal shows the English title as "Map of the railway between Potsdam and Berlin, 1838" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Landesvermessung und Geobasisinformation Brandenburg (LGB). Its keywords include opendata, Karte, Historisch. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
